$comment: Not a shadcn install target: nothing is ever added to this project from a registry. It existed so @tecton/eslint-config could find the Tailwind entry stylesheet and read the project's real theme, which is how it told a Tecton token from a class that generates no CSS at all. Tecton has removed that preset, so nothing in this workspace reads this file; it is kept as the standard record of which Tecton style the project renders with.
